spans.s: सौपर्णेय m. An epithet of Garuḍa.
सौप्तिक (I) a. (f. की) Connected with sleep.
सौप्तिक (II) n. A night-attack, an attack on sleeping men.
सौप्तिक (I) a. (f. की) Connected with sleep.
सौप्तिक-वध m. the great noctural slaughter of the Pāṇḍava camp by Aśvatthāman, Kṛtavarman and Kṛpa, मार्गो ह्येष नरेंद्रसौप्तिकवधे पूर्वं कृतो द्रौणिना Mrich.iii.
